name: DPT Visa Card
summary: DPT is a Hong Kong-based stablecoin card that lets you spend USDT and USDC wherever Visa is accepted. The entry-level Oxygen card has no monthly fee and unlimited default spending, but funding is stablecoin-only, ATM withdrawals are capped, and US citizens cannot apply.

limits.atmWithdrawal: US$250 per transaction · US$750 / day (3 attempts)

rewards.welcomeBonus: US$5 spending credit on card activation (non-withdrawable)

kyc.notes: Verification requires a government-issued ID and a live selfie. US citizens cannot sign up, though non-US citizens lawfully resident in the US may apply. Cards cannot be issued to residents of prohibited jurisdictions.

pros: No monthly fee on the Oxygen card and a low US$10 virtual issuance fee
Unlimited default spending and no balance cap (limits are set by you in the app)
Spends USDT and USDC across Ethereum, TRON, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana and Base
Instant virtual Visa with Apple Pay and Google Pay, plus a US$5 activation credit
cons: US citizens cannot use DPT, and several major markets are prohibited for card issuance
Funding is stablecoin-only: no BTC, ETH or other crypto can be deposited
ATM withdrawals are capped at US$250 per transaction and US$750 per day, with a 2% fee
The physical card costs US$50 and the premium Obsidian tier is US$10,000 per year

faq.question: Is the DPT card available in the United States?
faq.answer: DPT card services are not available to US citizens. Non-US citizens who are lawfully resident in the United States may still register and apply. USD is supported for worldwide deposits and withdrawals.

faq.question: Do I need to complete KYC to use the DPT card?
faq.answer: Yes. Before a card is issued you must complete identity verification with a government-issued ID and a live selfie. Applications from prohibited jurisdictions are rejected.

faq.question: Which cryptocurrencies does the DPT card support?
faq.answer: DPT accepts deposits in USDT and USDC. Supported networks are Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum One, Solana and BSC for both coins, Base for USDC only, and TRON for USDT only.

faq.question: Does the DPT card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: The Oxygen card has no monthly fee; there is only a one-time US$10 application fee for the virtual card (US$50 for physical). The premium Obsidian tier is charged as an annual membership of US$10,000 per year.

faq.question: What are the DPT ATM withdrawal limits?
faq.answer: ATM withdrawals are capped at US$250 per transaction and three attempts per rolling 24-hour period (US$750 per day). Both approved and declined attempts count toward the daily limit, and a 2% withdrawal fee applies.

howToGet: Download the DPT app and start sign-up with your email.
Complete identity verification with a government-issued ID and a live selfie.
Choose the Oxygen card and pay the one-time application fee (US$10 virtual or US$50 physical).
Activate your card in the app to claim the US$5 spending credit.
Top up with USDT or USDC over a supported network.
Add the card to Apple Pay or Google Pay and start spending wherever Visa is accepted.
availabilityNotes: DPT cards can be used anywhere Visa is accepted, but they cannot be issued to residents of the prohibited jurisdictions listed above. US citizens cannot sign up, though non-US citizens resident in the US may apply. Card spending is additionally blocked in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Ukraine and Venezuela.
